column1: # derivation: §4.6: strings order by their UTF-8 bytes, a prefix first;
# §7.14: no padding, 'abc' = 'abc ' is FALSE; §1.2: a NULL operand gives
# NULL (rows 6 and 8, and s < t where t is NULL: rows 2 and 5). First
# lt_Z (Z is 5A): TRUE only for '' and "S..." (53); lowercase letters (61,
# 68) and non-ASCII (E6, F0) sort after Z. lt_hz: "abc" and "a" U+1F600
# "b" (61 < 68), '' and "S..." TRUE; "h" U+00E9 "llo" ties on h, then C3 >
# 7A: FALSE. lt_abcd: "abc" is a prefix, TRUE; '' TRUE; "S" 53 < 61 TRUE;
# "a" U+1F600 "b" ties on a, then F0 > 62: FALSE. s_lt_t: 1 "abc" < "x"
# TRUE; 3 nothing is below '': FALSE; 4 61 > 2D: FALSE; 7 53 < C3 TRUE;
# 9 F0 > EF (U+FF21): FALSE, though UTF-16 would put U+1F600 (D83D) first.
# Types: BOOLEAN, nullable (§8.8); id as scanned.
